benchmark: synthetic actual DescriptorHeapRegistry::copy_descriptors elapsed wall time
sampling: separate prebuilt binaries; one untimed outer invocation each, then alternating A/B pairs; each invocation constructs heaps and warms one copy before timing; non-alias workloads alternate two distinct source streams so destinations change on every timed call; alias controls repeat identical sources; complete descriptor checks and hashing outside timing
unmeasured: game descriptor distributions/frequency, browser/Wasm, GPU work, game frame times, allocation latency of first-call interval scratch, retained metadata RSS
limitations: Synthetic native CPU public-method bookkeeping; no GPU commands executed, browser/Wasm or actual game distribution/FPS measured. Same-heap intersection algorithm unchanged; timing shifts there are not attributed as algorithmic gains.
